claims.content: The C2 JU terminates surveillance track reporting by transmitting drop track report messages and purges remote tracks that have not been updated within a specified time interval.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU terminates surveillance track reporting by transmitting drop track report messages and purges remote tracks that have not been updated within a specified time interval.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has surveillance tracks that need to be terminated or purged.
For terminating own tracks, the C2 JU currently has R² (reporting responsibility) for the track.
The track is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met (for EW surveillance data).
For purging remote tracks, a specified time interval has elapsed since the track's last report.
The system has not received a J7.0 (ACT=0) message for the remote track being purged.

The C2 JU initiates the termination and purge of surveillance tracks when it ceases reporting a track for which it has reporting responsibility (R²), when the track information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met, or when a specified time interval has elapsed since a remote track's last report without receiving a drop track message.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU initiates the termination and purge of surveillance tracks when it ceases reporting a track for which it has reporting responsibility (R²), when the track information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met, or when a specified time interval has elapsed since a remote track's last report without receiving a drop track message.

claims.content: When the C2 JU ceases reporting a surveillance track for which it currently has reporting responsibility (R²), it transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message, except when relinquishing R² to another JU or when the track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.

For Electronic Warfare surveillance data, when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met, the C2 JU terminates transmission and may purge the information in accordance with system design.
When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information that it has been reporting on the interface, it transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message; this message is not transmitted for remote reports.

The C2 JU automatically purges remote tracks/points after a specified time interval has elapsed since the track's/point's last report, without transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message for the purged remote track.

For ballistic missile tracks, the C2 JU transmits a J7.0 message with Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) when ceasing reporting a track for which it has R², except when relinquishing R² to another JU.

Remote ballistic missile tracks are automatically purged by the system after a specific time interval if no J7.0 Drop Track Report message is received and no further updates occur; this time interval is a system-selected parameter.
When a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU, it does not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message.
When a track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN, the JU does not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message.

If it is desired to change the simulation status of a track due to operator error, the track shall be dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and a new track shall be reported, except that a change from live to simulated shall be accepted if the track is being received from an FJU.
When a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU, it does not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message.
When a track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN, the JU does not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message.

If it is desired to change the simulation status of a track due to operator error, the track shall be dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and a new track shall be reported, except that a change from live to simulated shall be accepted if the track is being received from an FJU.

The C2 JU has transmitted a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message for own tracks where reporting responsibility (R²) is ceased, except when R² is relinquished to another JU or the track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.

For Electronic Warfare (EW) surveillance data, transmission has been terminated because the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met, and the information may have been purged in accordance with system design.

A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message has been transmitted by the C2 JU when dropping or ceasing reporting of EW information that it was reporting on the interface; this message is not transmitted for remote reports.

Remote tracks/points have been automatically purged by the system after a specified time interval has elapsed since the track's/point's last report, without transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message for the purged remote track/point.

For ballistic missile tracks, a J7.0 message with Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) has been transmitted when ceasing reporting a track for which the C2 JU has R², except when relinquishing R² to another JU.

Remote ballistic missile tracks have been automatically purged by the system after a specific time interval if no J7.0 Drop Track Report message is received and no further updates occur; this time interval is a system-selected parameter.

If a change in simulation status of a track was required due to operator error, the track was dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and a new track was reported, except that a change from live to simulated was accepted if the track was being received from an FJU.
